data.title: An AI answer for the FAQ page

message.text: We want to put this AI assistant answer on the e-wallet FAQ page.

chat.text: What is the minimum age to open an e-wallet account?
According to Ministerial Regulation No. 99 of 2025, the minimum age is 13.

explanation: The cited regulation cannot be found, a sign the AI made up its source (hallucination). Ask for a revision: check the official rules before publishing.
hints: Which part of the answer can be fact-checked?

source.text: Ministerial Regulation No. 99 of 2025 was not found in the regulation database.
